info.title: omnicore-mcp: a Model Context Protocol server (stdio) for an OmniCore database.
info.description: omnicore-mcp, a Model Context Protocol server for the OmniCore database: schema, queries, aggregates, views and dashboards for AI assistants, with the signed-in user's permissions. Signs in with occtl's saved context.

options.name: --context
options.description: The occtl context to use (default: occtl's current context). Env: OMNICORE_MCP_CONTEXT

options.name: --allow-writes
options.description: Also offer tools that change data and schema. Env: OMNICORE_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES=true

options.name: --max-rows
options.description: Most entities or rows per tool call (default 100).

options.name: --max-chars
options.description: Most characters of JSON per tool call (default 40000).
